configurePresets.name: wsl-gcc
configurePresets.displayName: Linux GCC (CI; shipped integral ceiling, see ci.yml)
configurePresets.description: Debug parity configuration. It names no QCX_INTEGRALS_LMAX, so the configure takes the 6 that integrals/CMakeLists.txt ships (154 instantiated MD classes) - the bound the engine supports, and the only class matrix CI builds since the owner's 2026-10-20 ruling. It used to pin 2 (24 classes). AN EXISTING build/wsl-gcc TREE KEEPS THE OLD VALUE: the cache entry is set without FORCE, so a tree that already holds 2 goes on holding it; delete it or edit CMakeCache.txt rather than assume this preset moved it. The Debug selection skips the two footprint cases through the same fast-mode gate every other heavy numerical case uses; Release at 6 runs them, and the measurements are on the windows-msvc Configure note in ci.yml.

configurePresets.name: wsl-clang
configurePresets.displayName: Linux Clang (CI; shipped integral ceiling, see ci.yml)
configurePresets.description: Same ceiling and same reason as wsl-gcc - read that preset's description; only the compiler differs. The docs and clang-tidy jobs configure through this preset, so they too see the full matrix; clang-tidy must materialize every PCH before it parses, and the 154 class-object targets make its build the heaviest in the file. It runs no tests, so the two footprint cases do not apply there.

configurePresets.name: wsl-gcc-release
configurePresets.displayName: Linux GCC Release (CI; shipped integral ceiling, see ci.yml)
configurePresets.description: Release parity configuration. It names no QCX_INTEGRALS_LMAX either, so the configure takes the 6 that integrals/CMakeLists.txt ships (154 instantiated MD classes) - the bound the engine supports and the matrix every CI leg now builds; a preset that pinned a smaller matrix would silently build a different program than the release does. COST, measured on this tree 2026-09-20 (12 cores, g++, no ccache, one machine): a full Release build is 9m37s here against 7m26s at a ceiling of 2, so about two minutes eleven more compile on every full build; the routine test selection is 42m40s against 42m12s, i.e. nothing. In exchange 55 routine tests stop skipping. AN EXISTING BUILD DIRECTORY KEEPS THE OLD VALUE: integrals/CMakeLists.txt sets this as a cache entry without FORCE, so a tree that already holds 2 goes on holding it - delete build/wsl-gcc-release or edit its CMakeCache.txt to pick the new ceiling up rather than assume the preset moved it. The same applies to the Debug presets.

configurePresets.name: wsl-clang-release
configurePresets.displayName: Linux Clang Release (CI; shipped integral ceiling, see ci.yml)
configurePresets.description: Same ceiling and same cost as wsl-gcc-release - read that preset's description; the numbers are not repeated here because a second copy is a second thing to keep true. This one names no QCX_INTEGRALS_LMAX either, so the configure takes the shipped 6.
